title: 第9章 红糐果第10章 看电视
lines: 第9章红糐果
遗传技能是从父辈那遗传过来的招式，并不需要后天学习，火之牙就是大多数火牙狗都会遗传的绝招。
虽说遗传技能是天生就会，但也别指望刚出生的幼兽就能释放出来，凡事都有个循序渐进的过程。
人天生就会吃，可也得从长牙喝奶开始。
技能的熟练度先是入门，下一阶段则是精通。
入门级别的技能都是威力不大，属于刚掌握不久。
低阶一点的技能基本到达了入门级别就能释放，可高阶的技能就算到了入门级别也不一定每次都能使用出来，这是还不够熟练的问题。
火之牙是中阶技能，按理来说火牙狗的火之牙才达到入门（2100）的程度，不应该释放的那么轻松。
可它做到了。
乔桑猜想是不是只要御兽典上显示出了火牙狗的技能，它就能够释放出来。
当然这一切都是她的猜想，还得以后火牙狗学会更高阶的技能才能认证。
乔桑意识退了出来，虽然她还想再研究一下点数的问题，但显然现在不是研究的时候。
只见那个熊孩子还跌坐在地上，漠尾狐浑身是伤，颈部还留着血。
乔桑拿出手机打了个661。
“喂，是御兽急救中心吗？我这里是杭港御兽中心，有只受伤的漠尾狐，麻烦能尽快来一趟。”
“有人打过了？哦，那没事了。”
乔桑挂掉电话没有再理会对面失神的女生，她抱起火牙狗准备回家，一转头发现一群人站在她身后。
人类的本质是爱看热闹，就打架那么点工夫，大半个场地的人都聚了过来，个别还举着手机拍着。
乔桑头皮发麻，抱起火牙狗就走，胖家鸠紧跟了上来。
“小妹妹，我看你很有资质，有兴趣当个主播吗？”一个染着红毛的青年来到她旁边。
“谢谢，没有。”乔桑绕过他。
“我能跟你进行一场宠兽对战吗？”一个戴着帽子的少年追了过来。
“不能。”乔桑拒绝道。
“同学，你是哪个学校的啊？”一个阿姨在旁边关心道。
乔桑回到家，母亲不在，餐桌上却放着一袋火系宠兽专门爱吃的红糐果。
这种能提升火系超凡生物体质的果实700联盟币一颗，偶尔吃可以，天天吃还真吃不消。
乔桑看着红糐果发了会呆。
她拿起一颗递到火牙狗嘴边，笑道：“你吃吧。”
火牙狗用鼻子闻了闻，它在宠兽基地吃的都是统一发放的压缩方块，并没有吃过这个。
闻着好闻，长得也跟它以前住的地方旁边那棵树上的东西差不多，只是颜色不一样，可惜那颗树上的东西它没吃到。
火牙狗不再迟疑，一口就把红糐果吞了下去。
content_en:
Chapter 9 Red Rice Fruit
Genetic skills are moves inherited from their parents and do not need to be learned. Fire Fang is a trick that most Fire Fang dogs inherit.
Although genetic skills are innate, don't expect that the newborn cubs can release them. Everything has a gradual process.
People are born to eat, but they have to start drinking milk when they grow teeth.
Skill proficiency starts with entry, and the next level is mastery.
Entry-level skills are not very powerful and have just been mastered.
Low-level skills can basically be released when you reach the entry-level, but high-level skills may not be able to be used every time even if you reach the entry-level. This is a problem of not being proficient enough.
Fire Fang is a mid-level skill. Logically speaking, Fire Fang Dog's Fire Fang has only reached the entry level (2100), so it shouldn't be released so easily.
But it did.
Qiao Sang wondered if the Fire Tooth Dog's skills could be unleashed as long as it was shown in the Beast Control Manual.
Of course, all this is just her conjecture, and it will only be verified after Fire Tooth Dog learns higher-level skills.
Qiao Sang retreated from consciousness. Although she wanted to study the point issue again, it was obvious that now was not the time to study it.
The naughty child was still sitting on the ground. The desert-tailed fox was covered in injuries and there was still blood on its neck.
Qiao Sang took out his mobile phone and dialed 661.
"Hey, is this the Animal Control Emergency Center? This is the Hanggang Animal Control Center. There is an injured desert-tailed fox. Please come over as soon as possible."
"Has anyone been beaten? Oh, then it's okay."
Qiao Sang hung up the phone and ignored the absent-minded girl opposite. She picked up the fire-toothed dog and was about to go home. When she turned around, she found a group of people standing behind her.
The nature of human beings is to love to watch the excitement, and for just a short time of fighting, most of the people in the venue gathered over, some of them holding up their mobile phones to take pictures.
Qiao Sang's scalp was numb, so he picked up the fire-toothed dog and left, followed closely by Fat Jiu.
"Little sister, I think you are very qualified. Are you interested in being an anchor?" A young man with dyed red hair came next to her.
"Thank you, no." Qiao Sang walked around him.
"Can I have a pet beast battle with you?" A young man wearing a hat chased after him.
"No." Qiao Sang refused.
"Classmate, which school are you from?" an aunt asked with concern from the side.
Qiao Sang: "..."
…
…
When Qiao Sang returned home, his mother was not there, but there was a bag of red wormwood fruits that fire beasts loved to eat on the dining table.
This fruit, which can improve the physique of extraordinary fire-type creatures, costs 700 alliance coins each. It's okay to eat it occasionally, but it's really too much to eat every day.
Qiao Sang was stunned for a while when he looked at the red glutinous rice fruit.
She picked up one and handed it to Fire Tooth Dog's mouth, smiling and saying, "Eat it."
Firefang Dog sniffed it with his nose. It only ate the compressed cubes distributed uniformly in the pet base, and had never eaten this.
It smelled good and looked similar to the thing on the tree next to where it used to live, but the color was different. Unfortunately, it didn't eat the thing on that tree.
The fire-toothed dog no longer hesitated and swallowed the red glutinous rice fruit in one gulp.
